limitations: AI source-based assessment, not expert or Alice Ting review.
The question chiefly tests generally applicable experimental-design reasoning; difficulty and learning gains have not been measured.
A negative delayed-biotin result does not certify the actual biotin-containing pulse history or every trafficking route.
reasoning_content contains a visible worked explanation, not a captured native hidden-thinking trajectory.

review.method: separate context, final question-only solve saved before opening key/sources; later source-aware worked-answer review

rubric_checks.clear_reasoning: Complete focused explanation, role of controls, each distractor and outcome-dependent limits.
rubric_checks.fair_input: Covalent-label background, substrate availability, expression/localization and fractionation observations supplied. Four plausible choices, one best under the temporal objective.
rubric_checks.reusable_biology_lesson: Differentiate photosensor recovery, cumulative labeling and endpoint recovery from post-illumination catalytic activity.
rubric_checks.supported_answer: Published control logic plus explicitly supplied hypothetical assumptions; observation and inference kept separate.
rubric_checks.variety: Adds cross-assay experimental-design judgment; single-item difficulty and collection diversity are not measured.

rubric_scope: Existing five preparation criteria applied; variety is a contribution to the collection, not a measured property of one item. No grading rubric is placed in the reader.
